name: defi
title: Defi
description: Switch windows, jump between workspaces, and run Defi window manager commands
author: qeude

commands.name: search-windows
commands.title: Search Windows
commands.description: Find any window Defi manages, then focus it, bring it here, or move it

commands.name: search-workspaces
commands.title: Search Workspaces
commands.description: Jump to a workspace on any display, or move the focused window there

commands.name: run-command
commands.title: Search Commands
commands.description: Run any Defi command; type 60 for a width or a workspace name to go there

preferences.name: defiApp
preferences.title: Defi App
preferences.description: Leave empty to use Defi.app from /Applications or ~/Applications.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
